source_refs.locator: Printed p. 60 (PDF p. 60), Table 1, climatic suitability levels for cocoa in the 2050s; source note cites Schroth et al. (2016).

evidence.scenario: The inspected table does not specify the climate-model scenario.
evidence.compact_statement: The CCDR’s cited projection shows land in Côte d’Ivoire rated over 50% suitable for cocoa falling by 57% in the 2050s, while lower-suitability classes expand.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: PDF p. 37 (one-based; web index P36), printed p. 9, climate-risk bullet on migration, northern insecurity and resource competition.

evidence.scenario: The inspected risk passage does not specify a climate scenario or numeric horizon.

pathways.compact_statement: Drought-related mobility may increase resource competition and tensions.
alternative_explanations: Historical tensions and resource governance also matter.
pathways.uncertainty: Prospective qualitative mechanism; no measured recruitment or causal conflict effect.
recommendations: Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.

pathways.compact_statement: In Bafing, seasonal resource scarcity intersects with transhumance, overlapping land use and crop damage to compound farmer-herder tensions.
alternative_explanations: Land-use expansion, corridor access, herd management, tenure and cross-border insecurity can cause tensions independently of climatic change.
pathways.uncertainty: Source-stated proposal/context mechanism using local studies and consultation; no representative incident sample or separate climate causal estimate.
recommendations: No structural linkage issue identified; review each cited passage for its specific causal link, alternatives and uncertainty before treating the pathway as verified.
